answer: One concrete mechanism: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because knoll only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, timber is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any gale approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
